t.zh: 彩色图的每个像素存三个数，各是哪种颜色，看存的顺序。OpenCV 读进来的照片按 B、G、R 存；拿去按 R、G、B 显示，红和蓝就对调了：一张蓝天的照片显示出橙色的天空。
t.en: A colour image stores three numbers a pixel, and which colour each is depends on the order they are stored in. A photo read with OpenCV is stored as B, G, R; shown as R, G, B, red and blue trade places, and a blue sky shows orange.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把这张照片的颜色换回来？新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出每个像素第 0、1 或 2 个位置上的数（在元件上设定），组成一张灰度图；<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图依次当作 R、G、B，合成一张彩色图。每个像素都和期望相符才算对。
t.en: This level asks: how do you put the photo's colours back? New parts: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes the number at position 0, 1 or 2 of every pixel, as set on the part, as a grey image; <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> takes three grey images as R, G and B, in that order, and makes one colour image. It is right when every pixel matches the expected one.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>的差别：OpenCV 按 BGR 存，Matplotlib 按 RGB 显示，交给另一个库前要换过来。
after.en: This is a difference of <wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>: OpenCV stores BGR and Matplotlib shows RGB, so swap the order before handing an image over.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?
